# StockSharp API Strategy Catalog

This directory contains StockSharp API strategy examples implemented in C# and Python. Strategy folders are split into numbered ranges (`0001-0100`, `0101-0200`, and so on), while the catalog below groups every strategy by its primary trading idea and links directly to both implementation folders.

Logos use theme-aware SVG files with prefers-color-scheme. Missing images are intentional placeholders: every row already points to the expected CS/logo.svg and PY/logo.svg paths so the catalog fills in automatically as the artwork is added.

**Strategies:** 3811
**Implementations:** C# and Python

## Categories

- [Arbitrage, Pairs & Relative Value (25)](#arbitrage)
- [Mean Reversion & Reversals (299)](#reversion)
- [Breakouts & Channels (319)](#breakout)
- [Volume, VWAP & Order Flow (63)](#volume)
- [Candlestick & Price Patterns (191)](#patterns)
- [Seasonal, Session & Event (92)](#seasonal)
- [Statistical, Adaptive & AI (77)](#statistical)
- [Factor, Portfolio & Rotation (24)](#factor)
- [Grid, DCA & Position Management (143)](#management)
- [Scalping & Execution (133)](#execution)
- [Volatility & Options (78)](#volatility)
- [Trend Following & Momentum (1033)](#trend)
- [Oscillators & Indicator Signals (203)](#oscillator)
- [Multi-Signal & Other (1131)](#other)
